sections.Profile:
"Champ" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in February 1974. Designed by Jim Patla with artwork by Christian Marche, the game features a sports theme and is known for its unique cabinet style.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Pinball, Sports, Original Theme, So Meta, 1970s, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Jim Patla
- Art: Christian Marche
